title: NiyamAI - An Intent-Bound AI Agent with Cryptographically Verifiable Guardrails using Zero-Knowledge Proofs
abstract: arXiv:2608.07167v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Autonomous LLM agents with tool execution capabilities introduce severe security risks through prompt injection, goal hijacking, and unauthorized action invocation. Existing guardrails rely on unverified, host local software filters system prompts, semantic classifiers, policy engines that share the execution environment of the untrusted agent, offering no guarantee to an external observer that a safety policy was correctly evaluated. A compromised host produces no evidence of its own failure. This paper presents NiyamAI, an intent bound runtime guardrail architecture providing cryptographically verifiable execution integrity for autonomous agents. At session initialization, permitted tools and operational constraints are sealed into an immutable Intent Contract under a SHA256 commitment. Every tool invocation is intercepted by a deterministic authority gate and classified by a dedicated neural Judge (11->8->2 feedforward network). F

translated_title: NiyamAI——一种基于零知识证明、具有密码学可验证护栏的意图绑定AI代理
translated_abstract: 具备工具执行能力的自主LLM代理通过提示注入、目标劫持和未授权动作调用引入了严重的安全风险。现有的护栏依赖于未经验证的、主机本地的软件过滤器（如系统提示、语义分类器、策略引擎），这些过滤器与不受信任的代理共享执行环境，无法向外部观察者保证安全策略被正确评估。被攻破的主机不会产生自身失败的证据。本文提出了NiyamAI，一种意图绑定的运行时护栏架构，为自主代理提供密码学可验证的执行完整性。在会话初始化时，允许的工具和操作约束被密封到不可变的意图契约中，并附带SHA256承诺。每次工具调用都由确定性权威门拦截，并由专用神经法官（11->8->2前馈网络）进行分类。
tldr: NiyamAI通过SHA256承诺的意图契约和零知识证明，为LLM代理提供密码学可验证的运行时护栏，确保每次工具调用都受确定性权威门和神经法官的验证。
en_tdlr: NiyamAI provides cryptographically verifiable runtime guardrails for LLM agents through SHA256-committed intent contracts and zero-knowledge proofs, ensuring every tool invocation is validated by a deterministic authority gate and neural judge.
